ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: Header only adapters between GUCEF and the Ogre 1.x API
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Ogre data streams over CIOAccess and over resources of the VFS, a CIOAccess over an Ogre data stream, the mapping of the Ogre log levels to the GUCEF logs, and the Ogre archives over a directory of the VFS, over an archive file of the VFS and over named in-memory resources. The classes are compiled into each module that uses them, so a plugin set for another Ogre line can use the same sources.
